uncertain_sources: Several ASR lines around 00:03:45--00:04:24 are corrupt. The chapter retains only the surrounding causal distinction between the exterior and doomed interior.
Several ASR lines around 00:35:07--00:35:27 are corrupt. The compactified Schwarzschild geometry is reconstructed from the continuous explanation and the verified board frame.
The hyperbolic tangent is one convenient compactifying map, not a unique physical choice. Only monotonicity, bounded limits, and separate reparametrization of the two null coordinates are used.
The relativistic shell theorem is used in the operational Birkhoff form stated in the lecture: flat interior and Schwarzschild exterior. No junction-condition proof is supplied.
The Einstein-Rosen bridge drawing is a schematic spatial slice, not a literal embedding calculation or a traversable passage.
The ideal mirror questions change the assumed stress-energy history. Their answers are presented as causal thought experiments rather than realizable weightless-mirror engineering.
The growing early horizon refers to the areal radius of its cross-section on selected spacelike slices. The final Schwarzschild radius 2MG remains fixed.
The late claim about maximizing survival time is normalized to the standard proper-time statement between fixed events and is not treated as a new black-hole escape mechanism.
